comparison.objective: Establish double-block-and-bleed isolation before removing a line cap; candidate finishes threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered valve and bleed actuation followed by cap removal versus precision mandrel alignment, bimanual hammering, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Both block valves closed, bleed open, indicator light out, then cap removed versus four safe tang fractures and full physical containment.
comparison.reason: Energy-isolation sequencing and cap removal are meaningfully different from contact-driven insert-tang fracture.
